versions.changelog: Las imagenes salen de Gemini (Nano Banana 2) con GEMINI_API_KEY; Higgsfield queda solo para video. Puente con la seccion 3.1 y el comando exacto.
La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release of “carrusel-ilustrado-formula100k”, an automated Instagram carousel creator with unique illustrated slides.

- Generates fully rendered PNG carousels with minimalistic, hand-drawn Xiaohei illustrations, ready to post—no Canva required.
- Mixes illustration slides and UI mockup slides, supporting both conceptual and app showcase carousels.
- Smartly assigns one of 8 illustration types to each slide, based on slide content and storytelling needs.
- Uses Higgsfield for illustration rendering (if available); otherwise provides English prompts for manual illustration creation.
- Delivers images in sequence via Telegram, optimized for 4:5 aspect ratio (1080×1350px) with F100K accent orange.
- Activates automatically for commands related to “carrusel ilustrado”, ensuring a tailored visual experience for educational, sales, or storytelling carousels.
